name: feature-recon
description: Codebase feature reconnaissance: per-feature maturity, bugs, gaps and opportunities with cited evidence, plus a dashboard.

plugins.name: feature-recon
plugins.description: Reconnaissance sweep of any codebase, feature by feature: what works, what's broken, what's missing, what's untested. Emits one evidence-cited JSON state file per feature plus a rollup, renders a self-contained HTML dashboard, and turns the findings into ordered task files that update the report as fixes land.
